subject: Pro-bono compute support for faculty sabbatical project
messages:
From: Dr. Elena Morales <emorales@westbrook.edu>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: pro-bono compute for faculty sabbatical project

Hi Logan and Marissa,

I hope you are both well. I'm a tenured associate professor at Westbrook College (small liberal arts, PA) and will be on sabbatical next academic year to build an open dataset and prototype tools for low-resource humanities corpora. We would love to use Redwood Inference for model evaluations and some short-term fine-tuning experiments, but our department has essentially no discretionary budget.

Is there any program for educational/pro-bono compute credits or trial extensions that could support a faculty sabbatical? The work would be public-facing and we are happy to acknowledge Redwood in related publications and demos.

I attached a brief project summary and a department endorsement note. Happy to schedule a 20-minute call to walk through the scope.

Best,
Elena Morales
Associate Professor, Westbrook College
emorales@westbrook.edu
(412) 555-0199

Attachments: sabbatical_project_summary.pdf (3 pages), dept_endorsement_letter.pdf (1 page)

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Elena Morales <emorales@westbrook.edu>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: pro-bono compute for faculty sabbatical project

Hi Elena — thanks for reaching out and for the detailed materials. Really interesting project.

Quick Qs before I loop in our pilot/edu team:
- Is the dataset fully public-domain or will there be licensing restrictions?
- Do you anticipate any PII or private data in the corpus?
- Who would be the institutional signatory if we need a short MOU?

If you prefer, we can do a quick 20-min call this week. I can also loop in Ben from our education partnerships team to help with program details.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Partnerships (acting) | Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.ai

From: Dr. Elena Morales <emorales@westbrook.edu>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@westbrook.edu
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 13:28:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: pro-bono compute for faculty sabbatical project

Thanks Logan — answers inline:

- Licensing: The primary source material is public-domain transcriptions of 19th-century student newspapers; we'll release derivative materials under a CC-BY license.
- PII: We do a name-redaction pass historically; IRB confirmed the work is exempt (attaching the IRB certificate).
- Institutional signatory: Westbrook College Finance Office (finance@westbrook.edu) can sign basic MOUs; the department chair has endorsed the request as attached.

I'll join a call if helpful. Attaching the IRB exemption cert and a signed departmental endorsement.

Elena

Attachments: IRB_exemption_certificate.pdf, dept_endorsement_letter_signed.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Elena Morales <emorales@westbrook.edu>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2026 09:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: pro-bono compute for faculty sabbatical project

Hi Elena — really appreciate the materials and the publication plan. We have an internal EDU program that can offer a mixed package for community-facing academic work. High-level offer we can extend subject to the MOU and research-use terms:

- 50,000 free inference/embedding units (applied as credits)
- A 3-month trial extension (usage window starting when resources are provisioned)
- A short, signature-light MOU confirming public release and data handling commitments

Two compliance notes: we require IRB documentation or equivalent (you provided that), and a short acknowledgement in any public materials. We typically ask for a one-page summary at the end of the funded period.

Operational asks we need before provisioning:
1) A signed institutional endorsement (signed by financial signatory or department chair) — we can accept a scanned PDF.
2) Point of contact for billing (even if waived) — please supply name/email so our ops team has someone to reach.
3) Confirmation there is no embargoed/third-party-licensed data in the set.

If those are in place I can route this to our EDU grants queue. Ben — looping you to help with provisioning and timeline.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager, Education Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
Attachments referenced: EDU_program_terms.pdf (1 page)

From: Dr. Elena Morales <emorales@westbrook.edu>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@westbrook.edu
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: pro-bono compute for faculty sabbatical project

Marissa — thanks, this is great news.

I've attached the signed faculty sabbatical letter and the IRB certificate (again). For the billing contact: Sarah Kim, Business Office Director <finance@westbrook.edu>. She can sign a small MOU; we've confirmed with Legal that an acknowledgement is acceptable.

One more ask from our side: because this is small-college admin and the timeline is tight, would Redwood consider waiving any PO requirement and just accept an institutional email confirmation? Many of our small departments cannot process purchase orders quickly.

Attachments: faculty_sabbatical_letter_signed.pdf, IRB_exemption_certificate.pdf

Elena

Hi Elena — delighted to confirm we've provisionally approved the EDU package outlined below pending a short signature-light MOU. Operational details:

- Credits: 50,000 inference/embedding credits, valid for 3 months from provisioning.
- Start window: Tentatively provisioned once we receive the signed MOU or the institutional email confirmation from Sarah Kim (finance@westbrook.edu).
- PO waiver: I escalated to Ops; for small nonprofits/schools we can accept a finance office email confirming the request in lieu of a PO. Sarah's email should suffice; please ask her to reply to this thread with an explicit confirmation.

Ben/Ops — please provision the EDU credits for "Westbrook College — Morales Sabattical" once Sarah confirms by reply and upload the quick MOU to the Drive link below so Elena can sign.
